body:
Fix offered, not landed: **3b5e049fac8dabd9baddde1e8396c4ef0f4eac36**, personal `fix/sam-packed-capacity`, one commit on next fbfb319f. `Packed::new` counts lines as `count.div_ceil(128 / N)`, the same lines for every count that fits, and two release tests (N = 16, 32) expect the capacity panic at the first overflowing count.

- ARM VM (`r88-fix-packed-arm-20261108T164603-86828e97`): 201 release tests, 21 docs, fmt, no-default, warnings-denied rustdoc pass; with the old line restored temporarily, both new tests fail; source restored byte for byte.
- EPYC `check` (`r88-fix-packed-check-epyc-20261108T165118-1d4abecb`), bench 7ea20449, the three Merkle-leaf points that build `Packed`: no cell slower, no instruction movement beyond 0.5%. 269 points unmeasured.

Yours to take, change or drop.

— Sam Shackleton
